Sitecore CMS Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Sitecore CMS Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $95,000–$130,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Sitecore CMS Developer to build and maintain enterprise digital experiences on Sitecore Experience Platform (XP), Sitecore XM Cloud, and Sitecore Content Hub. The role spans backend C#/.NET development, front-end work, content modeling, integrations, and platform upgrades, with a strong emphasis on modern composable patterns and migration from legacy implementations. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Sitecore work in production, navigates both classic XP/XM and the composable Sitecore ecosystem, and balances technical depth with editor and marketer needs.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of Sitecore development experience.
  • Deep expertise in C#/.NET and Sitecore APIs.
  • Strong understanding of Sitecore Helix architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with Sitecore XP, XM, or XM Cloud.
  • Experience with headless implementations using JSS or Next.js.
  • Solid front-end skills with modern JavaScript and build tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for Sitecore deployments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Sitecore Certified Developer credentials.
  • Experience with XM Cloud migrations.
  • Familiarity with Sitecore Content Hub, CDP, or Personalize.
  • Exposure to multi-brand or multi-region Sitecore deployments.
  • Experience with Sitecore OrderCloud commerce integrations.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Client Operations
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. About Us:Berkeley Payments is a leading payment technology provider specializing in innovative solutions for businesses to manage and process payments seamlessly.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Us:

Berkeley Payments is a leading payment technology provider specializing in innovative solutions for businesses to manage and process payments seamlessly. We power prepaid card and disbursement programs for some of Canada's largest enterprises, including major banks, payroll providers, and government programs, alongside 400+ generic card programs. We pride ourselves on combining deep payments expertise with modern technology to help our clients launch and scale payment programs that would otherwise take years to build.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a high-impact Senior Manager, Client Operations to own how Berkeley runs day two and beyond. Implementation gets a program live. This role keeps it running.

You will own every inbound channel into Berkeley: client support requests from enterprise program administrators, cardholder support across phone, IVR, email, and chat, and the technical escalations that surface behind both. You will lead the internal support team and the third party providers that extend it, and you will be the single accountable owner for service levels, first contact resolution, and cost to serve.

This role sits at the intersection of technical incident management, regulated fintech operations, and enterprise client communication. When a live program breaks, you run the response: you coordinate internal engineering, external processors and issuing banks, and client communication in parallel, then you write and defend the Root Cause Analysis in front of the client. When nothing is broken, you are rebuilding the support layer itself, migrating contact centre infrastructure, deploying Agentic AI and automated workflows, and driving unit costs down while resolution quality goes up.

This is not a ticket queue management role. You need enough payments and platform fluency to triage a transaction decline or a PIN retrieval failure without waiting on engineering, and enough operational discipline to run a regulated support function that enterprise clients and their auditors will scrutinise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Service Level Ownership: Own the operating metrics for the support function end to end, including first contact resolution, average speed of answer, average handle time, backlog aging, SLA attainment, client satisfaction, and cost per contact. Provide a single source of truth on support performance to executive leadership.

  • Cost to Serve: Own unit cost to serve across the portfolio and drive it down structurally through automation, self-serve deflection, knowledge management, and channel mix, not through service degradation.

  • Technical Incident Command: Serve as incident commander for production issues affecting live programs. Coordinate internal engineering, external processors, and issuing bank counterparts under time pressure while running client and cardholder communication in parallel. Own severity classification, escalation paths, and status cadence.

  • Root Cause Analysis: Own the RCA process. Ensure RCAs are technically accurate, delivered inside committed timelines, and defensible when presented to enterprise client stakeholders and their risk teams. Drive corrective actions to closure rather than filing the document and moving on.

  • Enterprise Operational Partnership: Act as the senior operational point of contact for marquee enterprise accounts, partnering with Client Success, who owns the commercial relationship. You own operational delivery, support performance reviews, and the credibility of Berkeley's answer when a client executive asks what happened and what changes.

  • Cardholder Support Operations: Own the cardholder experience across all contact channels, including dispute intake and resolution, complaint handling, card replacement and reissue flows, and identity and account access support. Ensure cardholder outcomes hold up under regulatory and network scrutiny.

  • Vendor and BPO Management: Own the third party support providers and the vendor stack behind them. Set scorecards, run quality assurance and call monitoring, hold vendors to contracted performance, and make the build versus buy versus offshore calls with real numbers behind them.

  • Support Infrastructure Leadership: Lead the modernization of Berkeley's client and cardholder support infrastructure, including CCaaS, telephony and IVR, ticketing, and knowledge base. Own the Go/No-Go decisions, vendor coordination, and cross functional roadmap for each migration.

  • AI and Automation Strategy: Design and implement an AI assisted support layer using Agentic tooling and automated workflows. Decide what gets automated, what stays human, and where an AI answer creates regulatory or reputational risk that is not worth the deflection.

  • Team Leadership: Lead the Client Support and Cardholder Support teams across internal staff and third party providers. Set standards for quality, tone, and technical accuracy. Build the coverage model, on call rotation, and career paths that let the function scale without burning people out.

  • Compliance Partnership: Partner with Compliance to ensure support operations meet FINTRAC, PCMLTFR, and PCI DSS requirements, including dispute handling obligations, network rules, complaint recordkeeping, and cardholder data handling on every channel.

  • Governance and Escalation: Define and enforce the escalation framework between support, engineering, product, and client-facing teams. Protect product and engineering capacity from unscoped support pull through by resolving at the right layer.

  • Process Improvement: Identify and remove systemic drivers of contact volume. Feed recurring failure patterns back into product and engineering as prioritised fixes. Build and maintain the run-books, macros, knowledge base, and reporting frameworks that scale as Berkeley grows.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in client operations, support operations, or service delivery leadership within FinTech, payments, or a highly regulated SaaS environment. Payments experience is strongly preferred and regulated environment experience is non-negotiable.

  • Proven experience leading technical incident response for enterprise grade clients, including writing and defending complex RCAs. You must be able to speak engineer and speak to client in the same hour.

  • Direct experience providing operational support to named, high revenue enterprise accounts, including reporting to client side executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated people management experience leading support, service delivery, or contact centre teams, including managing third party or outsourced providers against contracted performance.

  • Working knowledge of payments compliance obligations, including AML and KYC, regulatory reporting, financial dispute and chargeback resolution, and PCI DSS constraints on support workflows.

  • Demonstrated success leading infrastructure implementations or migrations such as CCaaS, CRM, telephony, or Agentic AI deployments, with full accountability for vendor performance and outcome.

  • Strategic people operations experience. Not just managing an existing team but building one: designing structure, managing performance transitions, and scaling a workforce through rapid growth.

  • Technical fluency. Deep enough understanding of API-based integrations, card transaction flows, and processor workflows to triage credibly and challenge an engineering diagnosis when it does not hold up.

  • Data discipline. Able to instrument a support function, build the reporting yourself when needed, and make decisions from queue data rather than anecdote.

  • Proficiency with Zoho, Jira, Metabase, or equivalent platforms, and hands on experience with modern LLM based support agents.

  • Exceptional executive communication. Able to hold the room with C level enterprise client stakeholders during and after an incident, and earn their confidence.

  • Strong written communication. RCAs, incident updates, escalation notes, and operating reviews must be clear, concise, and defensible.

  • Comfort pushing back. Willing to tell clients, sales, and senior leadership when a commitment is not operationally deliverable, with the substance to back it up.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

What We Offer:

At Berkeley Payments, we believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. As a part of our team, you'll benefit from:

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a salary package that reflects your experience and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy health, dental, and vision coverage, along with paid time off.

  • Fully Remote Environment: We are a fully remote company, allowing you to work from anywhere, in a culture that prioritises output over hours.

  • Ownership and Impact: Be part of a small, agile team where your work has a direct and visible line to client retention and the company's bottom line.

  • Executive Visibility: A seat at the table for critical operational decisions, with regular exposure to the CEO and COO.

  • High-Growth Environment: Lead the transformation of Berkeley's operational layer during a pivotal period of infrastructure migration and AI adoption.

  • Professional Development: We invest in your growth through ongoing learning opportunities, mentorship, and chances to work with cutting-edge technologies.

  • Inclusive Culture: We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone's voice is heard and valued.

  • Exciting Fintech Landscape: Join a dynamic industry at the forefront of payments technology, where you'll tackle complex problems and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of fintech.

Don't meet every single requirement?

At Berkeley Payments, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description and you have a passion for learning and growth, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our client in the UK is a fast-growing digital marketing agency looking for an experienced Paid Ads Specialist to join their team. This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and enjoys taking ownership of client performance.

This role goes beyond campaign execution. The successful candidate will proactively identify opportunities, solve problems independently, communicate confidently with clients, and continuously improve campaign performance without requiring constant direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.
  • Develop and execute paid media strategies aligned with client objectives.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and implement proactive optimisations.
  • Identify issues before they become problems and present clear solutions.
  • Conduct regular performance analysis and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Lead client meetings with confidence, explaining campaign performance and strategy.
  • Prepare detailed end-of-month performance reports and present insights to clients.

  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure campaigns align with broader marketing strategies.
  • Stay up to date with platform changes, new advertising features, and industry trends.

Requirements

  • 3+ years' experience managing paid advertising campaigns.
  • Previous experience working within an agency (essential).
  • Strong experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of campaign optimisation, conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.
  • Experience with lead generation and e-commerce advertising campaigns.
  • Comfortable presenting campaign performance directly to clients.
  • Experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) - nice to have.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Highly proactive and self-driven.
  • Solutions-focused rather than problem-focused.
  • Able to work autonomously with minimal supervision.
  • Commercially minded and performance-driven.
  • Confident communicating with both technical and non-technical clients.
  • Honest, accountable, and dependable.

Program Outreach Coordinator

Ready to make a difference?

The Program Outreach Coordinator supports the successful delivery of energy efficiency and customer engagement programs through communications, event coordination, stakeholder outreach, and program administration. This role serves as a key liaison among internal program teams, trade allies, subcontractors, utility clients, and external stakeholders, ensuring timely communications, effective event execution, and accurate program information management.

The coordinator is responsible for managing email marketing campaigns, newsletters, stakeholder distribution lists, outreach events, trade ally communications, and program reporting activities. In addition, the role supports cross-functional teams through project coordination, meeting facilitation, CRM data management, and administrative support, helping to drive program participation and stakeholder engagement across multiple initiatives. This position plays a critical role in maintaining strong relationships with program partners while supporting the overall goals and objectives of the organization’s outreach and energy efficiency programs.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT USDataEQ uses social media and other customer feedback data to help our clients (large enterprise brands) generate better CX insights, manage risk, improve conduct reporting and optimise social customer service.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

DataEQ uses social media and other customer feedback data to help our clients (large enterprise brands) generate better CX insights, manage risk, improve conduct reporting and optimise social customer service. Data is at the heart of what we deliver, so our work requires a strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative methodologies, as well as the ability to structure data in innovative ways to address clients’ business problems.

ABOUT THE JOB

The DataEQ Analyst Team is an exciting group of passionate and detail-oriented insights experts who believe in the value of social media as a source of actionable business insights. We are looking to hire a senior insights analyst to fulfil a team lead position. We require someone who is first and foremost a great analyst. Someone who can take on in-depth, ad hoc and advanced reports, who critically engages with the brief and the data, and is confident to ask questions and make suggestions. Beyond this, the person will form part of the management team who collaborate to drive processes, advance methodology and guide team advancement and morale. The individual needs to be a self-starter but also someone who works collaboratively.

The analyst will provide clients with insights to inform strategic and operational interventions for a range of business use cases, from customer experience to governance. Our clients are leaders in a range of diverse industries including, financial services, telecommunications, and retail.

Using DataEQ’s proprietary platform, the analyst will compile reports based on quantitative and qualitative analysis of social media data. Our analysts work closely with account directors and directly with clients, to develop research briefs and present their report findings. Internally, analysts consult with a methodological eye on a variety of business projects and client solutions.

Our analysts are talented connectors of quantitative and qualitative consumer, competitor and market data, and are skilled at contextualising and communicating insights, verbally and visually. Our environment is fast-paced and deadline-driven, so you'll also need to manage your time in a way that balances time for thinking, with time for execution, and be willing to learn a lot as you go.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAY-TO-DAY

  • Using our proprietary software, you’ll analyse, segment, visualise and interpret social data into monthly, weekly, quarterly and annual reports, typically in PowerPoint format.
  • Creating compelling data stories, leveraging our core products to deliver informative, actionable insights.
  • Using AI in a responsible and supportive manner, to help overcome bottlenecks, extract accurate insights and ensure well-polished reports.
  • Presenting report findings to clients
  • Thinking about unique ways to report on our data
  • Weighing in on methodological components of reports, offering insight into how to improve existing measures where necessary
  • Partnering with internal DataEQ stakeholders to drive wider business objectives.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, including Social Sciences, Economics, Marketing or Arts
  • Excellent English skills, both spoken and written
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Previous experience writing reports for corporations is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of social research methods, including probability distributions, causation, variance, sampling, and social statistics
  • A strong track record of working under pressure to deadlines
  • Attention to detail and the ability to identify and communicate trends is a key competency for this role
  • An understanding and interest in data visualisation and storytelling
  • Curiosity and drive to understand and explain real-world phenomena and trends
  • Previous experience in a corporate or related field is highly advantageous, but not required
  • The ability to present to senior-level stakeholders
  • Experience in managing people

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

If you join our team, DataEQ will support you at work and at play. We have a dynamic and inclusive company culture and we hire people who put the smarts and hearts into everything they do. We are a fully remote company where you will have the flexibility to manage your own time because we focus on outcomes over inputs. Whilst our team is located around the world, the bulk of our team are based in Johannesburg and Cape Town, South Africa. Should you be located in one of these cities and you crave interpersonal connection, we do offer various opportunities to interact in person.

For those based in Johannesburg and Cape Town, we host “Together Tuesdays” within local co-working hubs, fostering vital in-person engagement. Additionally, our monthly informal socials allow the team to pivot from operational duties to focus on building rapport through lighthearted conversation and shared banter. In addition to our flexible and remote working culture which we LOVE, we have many more reasons why you should join our team:

  • Generous annual leave
  • Market related remuneration packages (including generous commission structures for our client-facing team members)
  • Regular company status meetings to ensure everyone is aligned and working towards the same purpose
  • Sabbatical benefit after 5 years of continuous service
  • Access to paid optional co-working space
  • Meeting-free days
  • A solid work from home setup, which includes a contribution towards your wifi expenses
  • Optional Medical Aid
  • Compulsory Pension and Group Life
  • Personal development budget
  • Regular team socials

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in South Africa only. You’ll have the flexibility to work from wherever you are based in South Africa, while staying connected with the wider team through our remote-first way of working.

Notice about the use of your Personal Information:

Please be advised that as part of our recruitment processes:

raw.title: 1118 | Senior AI-Native Engineer
raw.excerpt: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Native Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.
raw.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Native Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Role Overview

Our partner ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on — they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality.

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way — who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck.

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Agentic Development Systems

  • Lead the definition of spec and implementation standards for your feature area — write executable SDD/BDD specs that set the quality bar for your team, and keep them current as implementation evolves.
  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, and drive adoption of AI-first development practices within your team.
  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality.
  • Shape the team's agentic development norms: spec standards, attestation practices, and responsible AI tool use.
  • Act as an advocate for Agentic & Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — influence engineering practices, demonstrate real-world production delivery without manual coding bottlenecks, and align distributed teams around AI-first norms.

Feature Delivery

  • Lead the technical execution of complex features and cross-team systems, owning them end-to-end from spec through production.
  • Design, implement, and ship solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high-volume, high-availability SaaS environments.
  • Anticipate where complexity will compound — surface systemic risks early before they become problems for your team or your customers.

Code Quality & Review

  • Review AI-generated code and agentic attestations with the rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses and raise the bar for what "good" looks like.
  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behavior, not just execution paths.
  • Contribute to and help define the team's technical standards across all facets of the AI SDLC.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Serve as a go-to technical voice on engineering practices within your team; mentor L1 and L2 engineers and make the people around you better.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing.
  • Communicate clearly in writing — in specs, in code reviews, in async updates — to keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned.
  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations.

What Success Looks Like

  • You lead complex features from spec to production using agentic workflows, and can speak concretely to how that changed delivery speed and code quality.
  • Your specs are clear, your tests are meaningful, and your PRs tell a coherent story — your output is easy for teammates to review, extend, and maintain.
  • AI-generated code you've attested has not introduced regressions or security issues past your review; your attestation means something.
  • Junior engineers on your team are measurably better because of your mentorship and code review.
  • You anticipate where complexity will compound and surface it early — your team doesn't get surprised by problems you saw coming.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments.
  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) — you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment.
  • Proven experience creating and using agentic development systems with genuine rigor — spec-first workflows, attestation practices, BDD/SDD — this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job.
  • Demonstrated track record of shipping complex features independently, end-to-end.
  • Proficiency in modern backend/full-stack technologies, with strong experience in Golang, PHP, or Node.js/TypeScript ecosystem, along with solid unit/integration testing skills.
  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end).
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures.
  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling.
  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product.
  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology.

VIDIZMO is a US-headquartered AI and enterprise video intelligence company, recognized as a Microsoft Solutions Partner, serving Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and enterprises worldwide. Our AI-Powered Intelligence Hub leverages large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multimodal AI to deliver capabilities such as automated tagging, redaction, facial detection, sentiment analysis, and secure video/data management at scale.

As we expand into new public sector and enterprise markets, we are investing in building strategic alliances that extend our reach and accelerate adoption of our platform — particularly in public safety and government verticals.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Channel Partnership Manager to identify, structure, and grow strategic partnerships that drive long-term revenue and market expansion. Unlike a transactional channel sales role, this position is focused on building high-value, long-term alliances — with technology partners, resellers, and system integrators — that open new markets and deepen VIDIZMO's presence in public sector and public safety segments.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial instincts with a strategic mindset, and brings a proven track record in IT/enterprise sales or partnerships, ideally with SaaS-based products sold into government or public safety markets.

Key Responsibilities

Partnership Identification & Strategy

  • Research, identify, and evaluate potential strategic partners (technology vendors, resellers, SIs) aligned with VIDIZMO's public sector growth strategy
  • Build and maintain a partnership roadmap tied to revenue and market-expansion goals
  • Assess partner fit based on market presence, technical capability, and existing public sector relationships

Partnership Structuring & Negotiation

  • Design and negotiate partnership agreements, including co-sell models, revenue-share structures, and reseller terms
  • Align contractual terms with legal, finance, and sales leadership
  • Establish clear mutual success metrics and governance structures for each partnership

Public Sector Sales Support

  • Support partners throughout the full public sector sales cycle — from opportunity identification through procurement and close
  • Help partners navigate RFPs, compliance requirements, and government buying processes
  • Provide deal support, positioning guidance, and competitive intelligence tailored to public safety use cases (e.g., law enforcement, emergency management, justice systems)

Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for signed strategic partners
  • Conduct regular partner reviews to track performance against agreed KPIs (partner-sourced revenue, deal size, pipeline growth)
  • Proactively resolve conflicts and strengthen partner engagement over time

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with product, marketing, and direct sales teams to align messaging and joint go-to-market initiatives
  • Feed public sector market intelligence back into product and leadership planning
  • Collaborate with the Channel Sales Manager and broader sales team to ensure alignment between partnership strategy and day-to-day channel execution

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field (MBA preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in IT/enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, or business development
  • Demonstrated, quantifiable track record in sales or partnership-driven revenue growth (e.g., partner-sourced revenue, deal size, pipeline contribution, peer ranking)
  • Experience working within or selling into the public sector required; public safety experience strongly preferred
  • Experience with SaaS or cloud-based enterprise products strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of government procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and partner-led selling motions
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills across both partner organizations and internal teams
  • Experience structuring formal partnership/reseller agreements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing network of relationships with system integrators, resellers, or technology vendors serving government/public safety markets
  • Background in AI, video intelligence, data analytics, or adjacent enterprise software categories
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or similar public sector compliance frameworks
  • Experience managing multi-region or multi-country partnership portfolios

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary with performance-based incentive structure
  • Opportunity to shape VIDIZMO's strategic partnership strategy from an early stage
  • Work with a Microsoft Solutions Partner at the forefront of AI innovation
  • High-ownership, low-bureaucracy culture with direct access to leadership
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI/LLM-powered enterprise products

401K Plan with Employer Match

Generous Paid Time Off (24 Vacation days, 7 Sick days, 12 Company Holidays, Short Summer Fridays)

Company Laptop + additional tech accessories

The base pay for this position is targeted at $130,000 - $150,000 per year with bonus based on performance.

raw.description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance 

 

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.  

 

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,000 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of more than 3,500 megawatts.  

 

About the Opportunity  

 

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp. [FEU].

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join our Project Management Project Controls team as a Project Scheduler in the Construction and Design Services organization. We welcome candidates with varying levels of experience. The outlined responsibilities will apply to all positions. The level at which you join the organization will be determined based on your qualifications and prior experience.

FirstEnergy takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. In addition, your actual base salary will depend on various factors such as your skills, qualifications, and experience.

The estimated pay range for this role is $74,375- $112,200. The pay range for certain locations, including the state of New Jersey, include a 20% differential to account for an increased cost of living, making the pay range $89,250 - $134,640.

Responsibilities include:

  • As a mid-level scheduler, you would be expected to have more experience and expertise in project scheduling using Primavera P6. You should be comfortable working independently and capable of handling more complex projects. Your responsibilities would involve a higher level of independence in managing schedules and collaborating with project teams. You may even be tasked with assisting less experienced schedulers and team members by providing guidance, training, and support.
  • As a senior-level scheduler, you would be considered an expert in project scheduling, with extensive experience in managing complex projects and mentoring less experienced schedulers. You would play a critical role in guiding project teams, identifying and/or participating in process improvement initiatives, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Specific job responsibilities for every level may vary depending on the organization's needs and the complexity of the projects you become involved in, but here are some common tasks you might be expected to perform:

  1. Data Entry and Maintenance: Inputting project data into the Primavera P6 system, including project activities, durations, resources, and relationships between tasks. You will also be responsible for regularly updating and maintaining the schedule as the project progresses.
  2. Schedule Monitoring: Assisting in monitoring project progress by comparing actual work completed to the planned schedule. Identifying discrepancies and helping to develop corrective action plans.
  3. Generating Reports: Supporting and producing regular schedule reports and schedule updates for project managers. This may involve extracting data from P6 and presenting it in a clear and concise manner.
  4. Resource Management: Assisting in managing project resources by ensuring they are properly assigned to activities, and responsible groups are identified accurately.
  5. Risk Assessment: Supporting the identification and analysis of potential schedule risks and assisting in developing mitigation strategies.
  6. Collaboration: Working with the project team to collect information, verify progress, and ensure that the schedule reflects the most up-to-date status of the project.
  7. Training and Learning: Continuously learning and improving your knowledge of Primavera P6, project scheduling best practices, and project management processes and practices.
  8. Adherence to Standards: Following established scheduling procedures, company guidelines, and industry best practices to maintain data integrity and consistency.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's degree in project management, engineering, construction management, business administration or related degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 4 years of relevant work experience. Relevant work may include project scheduling, planning, or project management.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in project scheduling, planning, or project management. Relevant experience includes hands-on experience in developing, maintaining, and analyzing project schedules using tools like Primavera P6, ideally within construction or engineering environments, with demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate across project teams.
  • Professional certifications related to project management and scheduling is a plus.
  • Proficiency in project scheduling software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or other industry-standard tools is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey information.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently.
  • Familiarity with construction and design services industry practices and terminology is a plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity   

 

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability. No recruiters or agencies without a previously signed contract. Unable to sponsor or transfer H-1B visas at this time.   

 

Safety   

 

Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. We ensure employees have the tools, information, and processes to perform their duties in a manner that assures safety for themselves, their co-workers, our customers and the public. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident-free, injury-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety.   • Systems orientated including advanced Microsoft Excel skills, experience with ADP Smart Compliance, and Workday knowledge
  • Effective communicator with individuals at all levels of an organization

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

In this role, you will make outbound phone calls to business decision-makers and set qualified appointments for our clients’ sales teams.

This is an appointment-setting/lead-qualification role. It is not a customer service and not a full-cycle closing position.

Work Location

This is a 100% remote W2 position. Candidates must have a quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet.

What You’ll Do

  • Make outbound B2B phone calls to business contacts and decision-makers

SalesRoads runs a range of outbound programs across industries, audiences, and call difficulty levels.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Company: Snapsheet

Job Location: USA,Remote

About Snapsheet: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them into our core systems and processes across cloud-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170+ P&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the evolution of our industry-leading claims engine. Because we are hiring across multiple high-impact teams, your specific placement will be aligned with your technical strengths and our current initiatives.

In this role, you will architect scalable solutions, mentor emerging talent, and collaborate across departments to solve complex problems for our global partners. We look for "full-stack thinkers" who thrive in an agile, remote-first environment and are passionate about building purposeful technology that delivers real-world results.

Team Overview:

Communications & Documents (Sub-Team of Claims Management): Comms & docs are central to the insurance experience. At Snapsheet, we’re building an industry-leading ecosystem that removes friction for users at every step. We lead with a collaborative, quality-driven culture and a commitment to innovation.

What you’ll get:

  • Remote working environment - your new commute is however long it takes to walk to your desk!
  • Flexibility - empathy is ingrained in who we are and we are happy to offer a flexible PTO policy, casual dress code, and more!
  • Development - Mentorship programs, 1-on-1 management, promote when ready culture, quarterly internal promotion opportunities, and goal setting sessions.
  • Fun - Celebrations just because, yearly in-person and remote events, Snapsheet Swag, Employee Resource Groups, and more!

What we are looking for:

  • BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field
  • 5+ years of full-stack web development experience
    • Designing and building APIs
    • Designing schemas and performant queries for relational databases
    • Understanding of scalability challenges and performance of server-side code
  • Prior professional experience using React
  • Prior experience using Ruby on Rails a plus
  • Eagerness to learn from and work with a collaborative team
  • Commitment to quality and passion for technology and creating cutting-edge solutions
  • Ability to manage tasks and to contribute towards multiple initiatives during a sprint

Our tech stack:

  • Frameworks: Ruby on Rails and React
  • Methodology: Agile
  • Infrastructure: MySQL, S3, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Lambda, Docker, CloudFront

We’re Built to Grow With You – And That Starts With How We Support You

At Snapsheet, we know that growth doesn’t happen in a vacuum—it’s fueled by the right support at the right time. That’s why we’ve built a benefits experience designed to grow with you, wherever life takes you.

  • Choose from 2 robust medical plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield—plus, we contribute to your HSA when you enroll in our high-deductible health plan.
  • Offer two dental plans and one vision plan to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Peace of mind with company-paid Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance.
  • Additional protection through voluntary benefits like Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Legal Assistance.
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match—because your future is worth investing in.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 6 sessions per life incident to support your mental well-being.

Perks That Make Growing Here Even Better:

  • Flexible PTO and 7.5 company-observed holidays to recharge on your terms.
  • In-person connection points throughout the year including our annual Summit and Roadshows.
  • Snapsheet SWAG and surprise mailers to keep the spirit alive.
  • Endless opportunity to shape your path—career growth, learning, and real impact are all within reach.
  • Health and wellness campaigns that evolve with you year over year.

Compensation that Grows with You

For this position, the base salary range is $135,000 - $165,000. While this range serves as a guideline, your actual compensation will reflect your unique experience, skill set, and location.

At Snapsheet, we believe growth should be rewarded—our compensation and benefits are built to evolve with you as your career does.

We are currently unable to accept applications for candidates who reside in the following states: Alaska, California, Montana, North Dakota, New York, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wyoming.

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Snapsheet, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Snapsheet is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or accommodations, please let us know by emailing .

raw.description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

 

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. 
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

About GondolaBio

GondolaBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing breakthrough therapeutics for genetic diseases. GondolaBio is an independent sister company to BridgeBio, originally carved out in 2024 after securing $300M in private financing from external investors. GondolaBio aims to leverage cutting-edge biological research to discover, create, test, and deliver transformative medicines to treat patients who suffer from genetic diseases.

What You'll Do

You will design and execute integrative computational analyses spanning multiomics datasets to accelerate therapeutic discovery in rare and genetically defined diseases. Working independently in a collaborative, data-driven environment, you will identify opportunities where diverse biological data can answer challenging scientific questions, generate therapeutic hypotheses, and advance biomarker discovery. You will leverage AI-enabled computational approaches to accelerate scientific discovery while applying sound scientific judgment throughout the research process.

Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and interpret integrative computational analyses spanning transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic, and other biological data modalities to support target identification, biomarker discovery, mechanism-of-action studies, and translational research.
  • Integrate public and internal datasets to generate, prioritize, and refine therapeutic hypotheses across diverse disease programs.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional scientists to translate computational analyses into actionable scientific insights.
  • Communicate results clearly and effectively through presentations, written reports, and contributions to scientific publications and conferences.

Where You'll Work

This is a U.S.-based remote role with periodic travel (quarterly or as needed) to GondolaBio's Palo Alto office or conference locations.

Requirements

Who You Are

Required:

  • PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Genetics, or a related quantitative discipline with 5+ years of industry and/or postdoctoral experience applying computational methods to large-scale biological datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic, and related biological datasets to answer complex scientific questions.
  • Experience supporting biomarker discovery, translational research, or target identification in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical setting.
  • Working proficiency in Python for scientific computing and data analysis.
  • Comfortable tackling unfamiliar biological problems by rapidly learning new disease areas, identifying appropriate datasets, and integrating diverse evidence into actionable scientific insights.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive as an independent contributor in a collaborative, fast-moving research environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience with transcriptomic approaches, particularly single-cell RNA sequencing. Experience with spatial transcriptomics or related cellular profiling technologies is strongly preferred.
  • Experience using large language models and agentic AI workflows to accelerate computational biology research, with appropriate scientific validation of outputs.
  • Deep expertise in at least one area of computational biology while contributing broadly across multiomics analyses.

What We Offer

  • Patient Days, where we are fortunate to hear directly from individuals living with the conditions we are seeking to impact throughout the year and learn how we can improve our efforts.
  • A culture inspired by our values: put patients first, think independently, be radically transparent, every minute counts, and let the science speak.
  • An unyielding commitment to always putting patients first.
  • A decentralized model that enables our program teams to focus on advancing science and helping patients. Our affiliate structure is designed to eliminate bureaucracy and put decision-making power in the hands of those closest to the science.
  • A place where you own the vision – both for your program and your own career path.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven environment where we inspire ourselves and each other to always perform at the top of our game.
  • Access to learning and development resources to help you get in the best professional shape of your life.
  • Robust and market-competitive compensation & benefits package (Base, Performance Bonus, Equity, health, welfare & retirement programs).
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Rapid career advancement for strong performers.
  • Potential ability to work on multiple GondolaBio Pharma programs across multiple therapeutic areas over time.
  • Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is $155,000 to $205,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location. A bonus plan and equity will also be offered.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Employees of BridgeBio and all affiliated companies should work through their managers to inquire about and learn more about this role.

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

Skill Development & Career Paths:

Job Title

Director, Spatial Data Management - Remote

Job Description Summary

Location: United States/Canada
Scope: U.S.-Based with Global Coverage Level: Director

Role Overview

We are seeking a strategic leader to build and advance our Spatial Data Management capability across the Space Management, Planning and Occupancy service line.
This role is responsible for establishing and improving spatial data standards, governance, quality, and consistency across clients, tools, and regions—while translating those capabilities into better client outcomes, stronger workplace technology implementations, and scalable service delivery.
The Director, Spatial Data Management will partner across business, client, and technology teams to create repeatable solutions, modernize methodologies, strengthen documentation, and enhance the way spatial data supports decision-making, reporting, and workplace technology enablement.
This is a U.S.-based leadership role with global coverage and influence across a globally connected practice.

Job Description

What You Will Do

Lead the spatial data capability

  • Define and evolve spatial data standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Create repeatable processes for data quality, stewardship, audit readiness, and consistency.
  • Drive alignment across clients, tools, regions, and service delivery models.

Apply spatial data through a business lens

  • Translate spatial data discipline into practical business value for clients and the practice.
  • Improve reporting integrity, implementation quality, scalability, and decision support.
  • Use spatial and occupancy data to support predictive, data-driven decisions based on current occupancy models.
  • Optimize, implement, and manage advanced spatial systems that measure utilization and align workplace environments to business needs, helping increase operational effectiveness and productivity.
  • Help assess where modernization—including emerging AI opportunities—may improve workflows, reporting, or client value.

Partner with technology teams

  • Work closely with technology teams to support workplace technology implementations, re-implementations, and ongoing enablement.
  • Translate business needs into data, process, and platform requirements.
  • Help ensure data standards and governance align to implementation realities.

Modernize methods and delivery

  • Refresh and document playbooks, methodologies, process maps, and guidance related to space allocation, planning, audits, utilization, and live occupancy.
  • Build practical frameworks that improve repeatability, quality, and consistency across the practice.
  • Drive disciplined, constructive conversations about process, accountability, decision rights, and consistency to improve service delivery at scale.

Support clients and practice growth

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on spatial data integrity and modern space management practices.
  • Partner with clients to connect occupancy, utilization, and planning data to strategic workplace and portfolio decisions.
  • Contribute to thought leadership, reusable content, and practice development efforts.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen service delivery and support client growth.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in Spatial Data Management, workplace data, occupancy data, or related space management disciplines.
  • Strong experience in data governance, data consistency, stewardship, standards development, and quality control.
  • Experience applying data discipline through a business lens, including the ability to connect technical or operational work to business and client outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with technology teams to support system implementation, platform enablement, or business-to-technology translation.
  • Experience supporting workplace, occupancy, reservation, IWMS, or related workplace technology platforms.
  • Strong client-facing communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Experience creating playbooks, methodologies, standards, process documentation, or best-practice content.
  • A genuine appreciation for documentation and the discipline required to create clear, scalable, and reusable standards, workflows, and guidance.

Vans is the original brand rooted in the authentic lifestyle of skateboarding. We are driven by our mission to inspire and empower everyone to live “Off The Wall” – embracing the youthful spirit of freedom, non-conformity, and relentless progression. Yesterday’s “Off The Wall” moment is today’s new normal, and at Vans, we believe in constantly outdoing ourselves. Together with our communities across the globe, our vision is to push culture forward because we believe that the pursuit of progression never ends. We are constantly inspired by the future generation of positive catalysts within our community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with a team of people who think and live “Off the Wall,” Vans just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Vans Careers or .

What will you do?

The Senior Strategic Account Manager is responsible for driving profitable, long-term growth across key strategic wholesale accounts within the street sport-inspired marketplace. This role serves as a trusted business partner, translating consumer insights into growth strategies that strengthen account relationships, elevate brand presence, and deliver commercial results. The ideal candidate brings a balance of strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and entrepreneurial mindset, using data to identify opportunities and shape future growth plans. The ideal leader should have a genuine passion for product, understand its strategic importance, and be able to connect product decisions to broader business objectives, consumer needs, and long-term growth opportunities.

Working cross-functionally across Sales, Merchandising, Marketing, and Planning, they will align teams around a shared vision and execute initiatives that drive both brand and financial performance. Success in this role requires a consumer-first perspective, a passion for innovation, and the ability to build deep partnerships that position the brand for sustainable, long-term success.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

  • Drive profitable growth and strengthen strategic partnerships across key wholesale accounts, serving as the primary advocate for both the consumer and the brand.
  • Develop and execute account-specific growth strategies and long-range business plans that support sustainable revenue, market share, and brand health objectives.
  • Lead seasonal Go-To-Market (GTM) execution across footwear and apparel, aligning brand priorities with account opportunities to maximize impact and performance.
  • Leverage consumer, marketplace, and account insights to identify white-space opportunities, validate strategic decisions, and unlock new growth avenues.
  • Champion a digital-first and omnichannel approach, accelerating e-commerce growth and creating seamless consumer experiences across physical and digital touch points.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Planning, Operations, and Customer Service teams to deliver best-in-class consumer connectivity and flawless execution of brand initiatives.
  • Drive account forecasting, Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning, financial management, and sell-in/sell-through analysis to achieve revenue, profitability, and inventory objectives.
  • Monitor and manage operational execution, including order management, shipping performance, claims, allowances, markdowns, returns, and marketing investments.
  • Bring innovative and consumer-centric thinking to account partnerships, identifying new opportunities to elevate brand presence, drive engagement, and fuel long-term growth.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to both internal stakeholders and external partners, influencing decisions and aligning teams around a shared commercial vision.

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 7-10+ years of experience and professional achievements. While this position is fully remote, the ideal candidate will reside within the LA or NYC market to better service their client base.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • Business & Financial Acumen – Strong understanding of wholesale forecasting, Open-to-Buy (OTB) management, financial planning, sell-in/sell-through metrics, and profitability drivers.
